name: Orivo Business Hours Block
author: OrivoWP

sections.description:
The Business Hours block allows you to display your business operating hours in multiple elegant styles. Perfect for restaurants, shops, offices, and any business that needs to showcase their opening times.

Key Features:

  • 10+ Display Styles – Choose from simple lists, elegant cards, modern grids, and more
  • Full Customization – Customize colors, typography, spacing, and layout
  • Responsive Design – All styles work perfectly on mobile and desktop
  • Easy to Use – Simple interface to set your business hours
  • Flexible Format – Support for different time formats and special notes
  • Highlight Current Day – Automatically highlight today’s hours
  • Closed Days Support – Easy way to mark closed days
  • Special Notes – Add notes like “By appointment only” or “Holiday hours”

Available Styles:

  1. Simple List – Clean and minimal
  2. Card Style – Elegant cards with shadows
  3. Modern Grid – Contemporary grid layout
  4. Compact Table – Space-efficient table format
  5. Badge Style – Stylish badges for each day
  6. Timeline View – Vertical timeline layout
  7. Boxed Style – Bordered boxes for each day
  8. Minimal Dots – Minimal design with dot indicators
  9. Professional Table – Formal table layout
  10. Colorful Cards – Vibrant card-based design
  11. Split Layout – Day and time split design
  12. Rounded Style – Modern rounded corners design

Support

For support and feature requests, please visit our support forum or contact us through our website.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/business-hours directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress
  3. Add the Business Hours block to any post or page
  4. Configure your business hours and choose your preferred style
  5. Customize colors and appearance to match your brand
sections.faq:
Can I customize the colors and fonts?

Yes! The block includes comprehensive style controls in the block inspector. You can customize colors, fonts, spacing, and more.

Does it work on mobile devices?

Absolutely! All display styles are fully responsive and optimized for mobile viewing.

Can I add special notes for certain days?

Yes, you can add custom notes for any day, such as “By appointment only” or “Holiday hours”.

Does it highlight the current day?

Yes, the block automatically highlights today’s business hours to help visitors quickly find relevant information.

Can I show different hours for different days?

Yes, each day can have its own opening and closing times, or be marked as closed.

Is it compatible with my theme?

The block is designed to work with any WordPress theme and includes multiple style options to match different design aesthetics.
